北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴天，体感微凉 13℃，记得添衣保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy, feels a bit cool at 13°C. Remember to dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感 17℃ 略凉，出门别忘添件外套。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy, feels slightly cool at 17°C. Don't forget a jacket when you go out.
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天 20℃，体感 18℃ 舒适，注意别着凉哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy at 20°C, feels comfortable at 18°C. Be careful not to catch a cold.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，体感 28℃ 略闷热，多补充水分哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy, feels a bit muggy at 28°C. Remember to stay hydrated!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感 24℃ 略潮湿，记得带把伞哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is partly cloudy, feels warm and humid at 24°C. Stay comfy!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天 23℃，体感 21℃ 适宜，出行心情要美丽！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy at 23°C, feels pleasant at 21°C. Enjoy your day out!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 17℃ 稍有凉意，注意防风保暖。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy, feels a bit cool at 17°C. Mind the wind and stay warm.
南京.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天 18℃，湿度 71% 较高，出门带伞更安心。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy at 18°C with 71% humidity. Take an umbrella for peace of mind.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天 18℃，体感舒适，保持好心情哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy at 18°C, feels comfortable. Keep up your good spirits!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天 21℃，体感 20℃ 宜人，祝您一天愉快！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy at 21°C, feels pleasant at 20°C. Wish you a lovely day!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾 19℃，能见度不高，出行注意安全哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy at 19°C, visibility is low. Please travel safely.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阴天 12℃，体感 10℃ 偏冷，注意补水和保暖。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy at 12°C, feels chilly at 10°C. Remember to hydrate and stay warm.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴天，风力 4 级偏大，体感 10℃ 较冷，注意防风。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny but windy with a 10°C wind chill. Stay warm and protect yourself from the wind.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天 22℃，风力 4 级体感 14℃ 冷，记得添衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy at 22°C, but feels cold at 14°C due to strong winds. Dress warmly!
昆明.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天 20℃，体感 17℃ 略凉，带件薄外套备用哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy at 20°C, feels slightly cool at 17°C. Keep a light jacket handy.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛大雾 10℃，体感 5℃ 湿冷，出行注意安全添衣。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is very foggy at 10°C, feels damp and cold at 5°C. Travel safely and dress warmly.
青岛.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云 14℃，体感 8℃ 偏冷，风干物燥，注意补水。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is partly cloudy at 14°C, feels chilly at 8°C. It's dry, so remember to hydrate.
